title: N+1 query in payment listing endpoint
description: The /api/v1/payments/list endpoint executes a separate query per payment to fetch merchant details.
business_impact: p95 latency exceeds 200ms target under load above 2000 RPS.
technical_impact: Database connection pool exhaustion under high concurrency.

evidence.description: Loop with individual merchant query per payment.

validation_method: Load test with k6 + code review
remediation: Use a JOIN or batch query to fetch merchant details in a single query.

title: Single-region Redis cache
description: Redis cache deployed in single AZ without fallback.
business_impact: Redis failure causes session loss and 503 errors.
technical_impact: No cache fallback; session store unavailable on Redis failure.

evidence.description: Redis cluster configured with single AZ.

remediation: Configure Redis with multi-AZ replication and automatic failover.
